title: Hive Mind Source Entry Frontmatter
description: Required frontmatter on every `sources/**/*.md` file (excluding index.md). The pre-push Sentinel hook validates PII/credentials; this schema validates structural completeness.

source_type.description: Category of source material. Determines subdirectory placement under sources/. Aligned with the extract plugin's doc-type taxonomy so both deposit paths share one layout.

title.description: Human-readable title for the source (e.g., meeting name, document title).

date.description: ISO 8601 date the source material was created (meeting date, document date).

recorder.description: GitHub username of the person who deposited this source into the Hive.

participants.description: Optional list of participants (GitHub usernames or identifiable names). Relevant for meetings/calls.

duration_minutes.description: Optional duration in minutes. Relevant for meetings and recordings.

session_id.description: Optional Claude Code session identifier for attribution chain.

sentinel_override.description: Audit record of a user-approved override of pre-push Sentinel pattern match(es). Same semantics as inbox entries — see `protocol/sensitive-data-patterns.md` § Override audit trail.
